subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ300P across its F-Pace X761 application.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ300P is fitted in the F-Pace P400.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals, timing chain components where required, and the oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild. 48V MHEV ancillaries are also accounted for on this application.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the AJ300P. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ300P rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ300P REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine - illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals, timing chain components where required, and the oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild. 48V MHEV ancillaries are also accounted for on this application.

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
